name: Webhook: Order Event → Managed Table
description: Fired by POST /api/published/orders-webhook; the JSON body binds to ${param.*}.

params.query: SELECT '${param.order_id}' AS order_id, '${param.customer}' AS customer, CAST(${param.amount} AS DOUBLE) AS amount, CASE WHEN ${param.amount} >= 1000 THEN 'high' ELSE 'standard' END AS tier, now() AS received_at
